dct_title_s: Adair County, Iowa, 1961, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol BJT. Form of individual image numbering: BJT-1CC-[number], BJT-2CC-[number], or BJT-3CC-[number]. "Year flown 1961". Flown by Woltz Studios, Inc. Des Moines, 13, Iowa. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made].
